newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bank loan to Alunorte awaits Brazil move.
newsitem.headline: Japan bank loan to Alunorte awaits Brazil move.

text.p: The extension of a $200 million loan from the Export-Import Bank of Japan to Brazilian alumina producer Alunorte is awaiting Brazilian government approval of a guarantee for the loan, a Japanese source familiar with the case said on Wednesday.
He said such approval could come in the near future and denied a recent report that the loan was delayed by the Brazilian government.
"To my knowledge it has not been delayed," he said. "There are many parties involved, so it takes time."
He added that most of the conditions for extending the loan were in place, although it was still under negotiation.
Alunorte began operations in July 1995 and is expected to produce 900,000 tonnes of alumina this year.

Aluvale, the aluminium holding of Brazil's state-controlled mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce, holds a controlling stake in Alunorte, whose shareholders also include Nippon Amazon Aluminium Co, a Japanese consortium.
